tips: Reached off at 130° to the wind for the first 15–40 s after the mark (your best exited at 159°). Bear away all the way to the run angle first, then set.
Took 32 s to settle on the run (best 12 s). Pole and halyard ready on the layline, so the set happens as you bear away.
